```{r}
#| label: exclusions-all
#| include: false

# ── Experiment 1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# pid 1 excluded by inspection: 59% of trials > 2.5s
# no formal threshold applied (preregistered threshold introduced from Exp 2 onwards)
data_exp1 <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "data_exp_1.csv"))

list_participant_analysis_1 <- data_exp1 |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# ── Experiment 2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_exp2 <- read_csv(here(
  "exp_2", "data", "wrangle_data_exp_2.csv"
)) |>
  mutate(rt_excluded = is.na(rt) | rt > 2.0 | rt < 0.2)

exclude_rt_exp2 <- data_exp2 |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_excluded = mean(rt_excluded) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_excluded > 25) |>
  pull(pid)

exclude_acc_exp2 <- data_exp2 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_rt_exp2) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_acc < 55) |>
  pull(pid)

list_participant_analysis_2 <- data_exp2 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_rt_exp2, !pid %in% exclude_acc_exp2) |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# ── Experiment 3 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_exp3 <- read_csv(here("exp_3", "data", "raw_data_exp_3.csv"))

# ratings exclusion first
data_ratings_exp3 <- list.files(
  here("exp_3", "data"),
  pattern    = "Ratings.*csv",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive  = TRUE
) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_csv, col_names = c("Image_ID", "Fam_ratings", "Val_ratings", "Chosen_name")) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "file") |>
  mutate(pid = rep(1:40, each = 60)) |>
  select(-file)

exclude_ratings_exp3 <- data_ratings_exp3 |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(n_fam = sum(Fam_ratings > 6)) |>
  filter(n_fam < 30) |>
  pull(pid)

# accuracy on remaining participants only
acc_check_exp3 <- data_exp3 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp3) |>
  mutate(
    cond = if_else(fam == 1, "famous", "novel"),
    acc  = case_when(
      cond == "famous" & keypress == "q" ~ 1,
      cond == "novel"  & keypress == "p" ~ 1,
      TRUE                               ~ 0
    )
  ) |>
  drop_na(rt) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc) * 100)

over_95_pid  <- acc_check_exp3 |> filter(perc_acc > 95) |> pull(pid)
under_55_pid <- acc_check_exp3 |> filter(perc_acc < 55) |> pull(pid)

list_participant_analysis_3 <- data_exp3 |>
  filter(
    !pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp3,
    !pid %in% over_95_pid,
    !pid %in% under_55_pid
  ) |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# ── Experiment 4 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_exp4 <- read_csv(here("exp_4", "data", "wrangle_exp_4.csv")) |>
  mutate(rt_excluded = is.na(rt))

# ratings exclusion first
exclude_ratings_exp4 <- read_csv(here("exp_4", "data", "raw_exp_4.csv")) |>
  filter(!is.na(familiarity_rating)) |>
  rename(pid = participant) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(n_fam = sum(familiarity_rating > 6)) |>
  filter(n_fam < 30) |>
  pull(pid)

# RT exclusion on remaining participants
exclude_rt_exp4 <- data_exp4 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp4) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_excluded = mean(rt_excluded) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_excluded > 25) |>
  pull(pid)

# accuracy exclusion on remaining participants
exclude_acc_exp4 <- data_exp4 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp4, !pid %in% exclude_rt_exp4) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_acc < 55) |>
  pull(pid)

list_participant_analysis_4 <- data_exp4 |>
  filter(
    !pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp4,
    !pid %in% exclude_rt_exp4,
    !pid %in% exclude_acc_exp4
  ) |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)
```

```{r}
#| label: demographics-all

# ── Experiment 1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
demo_exp1 <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "demo_exp_1.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Index           = as.factor(Index),
    Gender          = as.factor(Gender),
    Date_of_birth   = lubridate::my(Date_of_birth),
    Date_of_testing = lubridate::dmy(`Date of testing`),
    Age             = floor(age_calc(Date_of_birth,
                                     enddate = Date_of_testing,
                                     units = "years"))
  )

# ── Experiment 2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
demo_exp2 <- read_csv(here("exp_2", "data", "demo_exp_2.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    `Participant id` = as.factor(`Participant id`),
    Sex              = as.factor(Sex),
    Age              = as.numeric(Age)
  )

# ── Experiment 3 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
demo_exp3 <- read_csv(here("exp_3", "data", "demo_exp_3.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Index  = as.factor(Index),
    Gender = as.factor(Gender),
    Age    = as.numeric(Age),
    pid    = row_number()
  )

# ── Experiment 4 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
demo_exp4 <- read_csv(here("exp_4", "data", "demo_exp_4.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    `Participant id` = as.factor(`Participant id`),
    Sex              = as.factor(Sex),
    Age              = as.numeric(Age)
  )

# ── Exp 1 inline text scalar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
rt_exp_1 <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "raw_data_exp_1.csv"))
perc_rt_1 <- rt_exp_1 |>
  filter(pid != "1") |>
  summarise(perc = round(mean(rt > 2, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 3)) |>
  pull(perc)
```

```{r}
#| label: participant-summary
#| include: false

participant_summary <- bind_rows(
  # Exp 1
  demo_exp1 |>
    filter(Index != "1.1-RF-01") |>
    mutate(gender = if_else(Gender == "F", "Female", "Male")) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 1",
      Setting                  = "Lab",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp1),
      Withdrew                 = 0,
      Completed                = nrow(demo_exp1) - 1L,
      `RT exclusions`          = 1,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = 0,
      `Familiarity exclusions` = "—",
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(gender == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(gender == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 2
  demo_exp2 |>
    filter(Status != "RETURNED",
           `Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_2) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 2",
      Setting                  = "Online",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp2),
      Withdrew                 = sum(demo_exp2$Status == "RETURNED"),
      Completed                = sum(demo_exp2$Status != "RETURNED"),
      `RT exclusions`          = excl_exp2$exclude_rt,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = excl_exp2$exclude_acc,
      `Familiarity exclusions` = "—",
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(Sex == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(Sex == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 3
  demo_exp3 |>
    filter(pid %in% list_participant_analysis_3) |>
    mutate(gender = if_else(Gender == "F", "Female", "Male")) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 3",
      Setting                  = "Lab",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp3),
      Withdrew                 = 0,
      Completed                = nrow(demo_exp3),
      `RT exclusions`          = excl_exp3$exclude_rt,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = excl_exp3$exclude_acc,
      `Familiarity exclusions` = as.character(excl_exp3$exclude_ratings),
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(gender == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(gender == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 4
  demo_exp4 |>
    filter(Status != "RETURNED",
           `Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_4) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 4",
      Setting                  = "Online",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp4),
      Withdrew                 = sum(demo_exp4$Status == "RETURNED"),
      Completed                = sum(demo_exp4$Status != "RETURNED"),
      `RT exclusions`          = excl_exp4$exclude_rt,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = excl_exp4$exclude_acc,
      `Familiarity exclusions` = as.character(excl_exp4$exclude_ratings),
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(Sex == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(Sex == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    )
)

# ── Experiment 1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exp1_row            <- participant_summary |> filter(Experiment == "Experiment 1")
started_exp1        <- exp1_row$Started
withdrew_exp1       <- exp1_row$Withdrew
completed_exp1      <- exp1_row$Completed
exclude_rt_exp1     <- exp1_row$`RT exclusions`
exclude_acc_exp1    <- exp1_row$`Accuracy exclusions`
final_n_exp1        <- exp1_row$`Final n`
male_exp1           <- exp1_row$Male
female_exp1         <- exp1_row$Female
mean_age_exp1       <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp1_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "^[0-9.]+"))
sd_age_exp1         <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp1_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "(?<=\\().*(?=\\))"))
min_age_exp1        <- min(demo_exp1$Age[demo_exp1$Index != "1.1-RF-01"])
max_age_exp1        <- max(demo_exp1$Age[demo_exp1$Index != "1.1-RF-01"])

# ── Experiment 2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exp2_row            <- participant_summary |> filter(Experiment == "Experiment 2")
started_exp2        <- exp2_row$Started
withdrew_exp2       <- exp2_row$Withdrew
completed_exp2      <- exp2_row$Completed
exclude_rt_exp2     <- exp2_row$`RT exclusions`
exclude_acc_exp2    <- exp2_row$`Accuracy exclusions`
final_n_exp2        <- exp2_row$`Final n`
male_exp2           <- exp2_row$Male
female_exp2         <- exp2_row$Female
mean_age_exp2       <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp2_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "^[0-9.]+"))
sd_age_exp2         <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp2_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "(?<=\\().*(?=\\))"))
min_age_exp2        <- min(demo_exp2$Age[demo_exp2$Status != "RETURNED" &
                           demo_exp2$`Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_2])
max_age_exp2        <- max(demo_exp2$Age[demo_exp2$Status != "RETURNED" &
                           demo_exp2$`Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_2])

# ── Experiment 3 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exp3_row            <- participant_summary |> filter(Experiment == "Experiment 3")
started_exp3        <- exp3_row$Started
withdrew_exp3       <- exp3_row$Withdrew
completed_exp3      <- exp3_row$Completed
exclude_rt_exp3     <- exp3_row$`RT exclusions`
exclude_acc_exp3    <- exp3_row$`Accuracy exclusions`
exclude_ratings_exp3 <- as.integer(exp3_row$`Familiarity exclusions`)
over_95_exp3        <- excl_exp3$over_95
under_55_exp3       <- excl_exp3$under_55
final_n_exp3        <- exp3_row$`Final n`
male_exp3           <- exp3_row$Male
female_exp3         <- exp3_row$Female
mean_age_exp3       <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp3_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "^[0-9.]+"))
sd_age_exp3         <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp3_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "(?<=\\().*(?=\\))"))
min_age_exp3        <- min(demo_exp3$Age[demo_exp3$pid %in% list_participant_analysis_3])
max_age_exp3        <- max(demo_exp3$Age[demo_exp3$pid %in% list_participant_analysis_3])

# ── Experiment 4 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exp4_row             <- participant_summary |> filter(Experiment == "Experiment 4")
started_exp4         <- exp4_row$Started
withdrew_exp4        <- exp4_row$Withdrew
completed_exp4       <- exp4_row$Completed
exclude_rt_exp4      <- exp4_row$`RT exclusions`
exclude_acc_exp4     <- exp4_row$`Accuracy exclusions`
exclude_ratings_exp4 <- as.integer(exp4_row$`Familiarity exclusions`)
final_n_exp4         <- exp4_row$`Final n`

female_exp4          <- exp4_row$Female

sd_age_exp4          <- as.numeric(str_extract(exp4_row$`Mean age (SD)`, "(?<=\\().*(?=\\))"))

max_age_exp4         <- max(demo_exp4$Age[demo_exp4$Status != "RETURNED" &
                            demo_exp4$`Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_4])
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-participants

participant_summary <- bind_rows(
  # Exp 1
  demo_exp1 |>
    filter(Index != "1.1-RF-01") |>
    mutate(gender = if_else(Gender == "F", "Female", "Male")) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 1",
      Setting                  = "Lab",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp1),
      Withdrew                 = 0,
      Completed                = nrow(demo_exp1) - 1L,  # 1 excluded for RT
      `RT exclusions`          = 1,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = 0,
      `Familiarity exclusions` = "—",
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                    = sum(gender == "Female"),
      Male                      = sum(gender == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 2
  demo_exp2 |>
    filter(Status != "RETURNED",
           `Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_2) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 2",
      Setting                  = "Online",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp2),
      Withdrew                 = sum(demo_exp2$Status == "RETURNED"),
      Completed                = sum(demo_exp2$Status != "RETURNED"),
      `RT exclusions`          = length(exclude_rt_exp2),
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = length(exclude_acc_exp2),
      `Familiarity exclusions` = "—",
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(Sex == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(Sex == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 3
  demo_exp3 |>
    filter(pid %in% list_participant_analysis_3) |>
    mutate(gender = if_else(Gender == "F", "Female", "Male")) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 3",
      Setting                  = "Lab",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp3),
      Withdrew                 = 0,
      Completed                = nrow(demo_exp3),
      `RT exclusions`          = 0,
      `Accuracy exclusions`    = length(over_95_pid) + length(under_55_pid),
      `Familiarity exclusions` = as.character(length(exclude_ratings_exp3)),
      `Final n`                = n(),
      Female                   = sum(gender == "Female"),
      Male                     = sum(gender == "Male"),
      `Mean age (SD)`          = paste0(round(mean(Age), 1), " (", round(sd(Age), 1), ")")
    ),

  # Exp 4
  demo_exp4 |>
    filter(Status != "RETURNED",
           `Participant id` %in% list_participant_analysis_4) |>
    summarise(
      Experiment               = "Experiment 4",
      Setting                  = "Online",
      Started                  = nrow(demo_exp4),
      Withdrew                 = sum(demo_exp4$Status == "RETURNED"),
      Completed                = sum(demo_exp4$Status != "RETURNED"),
```

```{r}
#| label: demo-exp1
#| include: false

## read in demographic data
demo_exp1 <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "demo_exp_1.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Index            = as.factor(Index),
    Gender           = as.factor(Gender),
    Date_of_birth    = lubridate::my(Date_of_birth),
    Date_of_testing  = lubridate::dmy(`Date of testing`),
    Age              = floor(age_calc(Date_of_birth, 
                                      enddate = Date_of_testing,
                                      units = "years"))
  )

# Summary stats 
exp1_demo_stats <- demo_exp1 |>
  filter(Index != "1.1-RF-01") |>
  summarise(
    n       = n(),
    n_male  = sum(Gender == "M"),
    n_female = sum(Gender == "F"),
    mean_age = round(mean(Age), 2),
    sd_age   = round(sd(Age), 2),
    min_age  = min(Age),
    max_age  = max(Age)
```

```{r}
#| label: exclusion-exp2

data_exp2 <- read_csv(here(

  "data",

  mutate(rt_excluded = is.na(rt) | rt > 2.0)

  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_excluded = mean(rt_excluded) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_excluded > 25) |>
  pull(pid)

# Accuracy exclusion — participants with <55% accuracy on responded trials
exclude_acc_exp2 <- data_exp2 |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_rt_exp2) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_acc < 55) |>
  pull(pid)

# Final retained participant list
list_participant_analysis_2 <- data_exp2 |>
  filter(
    !pid %in% exclude_rt_exp2,
    !pid %in% exclude_acc_exp2
  ) |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# Scalar counts for inline text
part_trial_25                 <- length(exclude_rt_exp2)
part_acc_55                   <- length(exclude_acc_exp2)
number_participant_analysis_2 <- length(list_participant_analysis_2)
```

```{r}
#| label: exclusion-exp3
#| include: false

# Load raw data
data_exp3 <- read_csv(here("exp_3", "data", "raw_data_exp_3.csv"))

# Accuracy check — recode condition and accuracy from raw columns
acc_check_exp3 <- data_exp3 |>
  mutate(
    cond = if_else(fam == 1, "famous", "novel"),
    acc  = case_when(
      cond == "famous" & keypress == "q" ~ 1,
      cond == "novel"  & keypress == "p" ~ 1,
      TRUE                               ~ 0
    )
  ) |>
  drop_na(rt) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc) * 100)

# Over 95% accuracy
over_95_pid <- acc_check_exp3 |>
  filter(perc_acc > 95) |>
  pull(pid)

# Under 55% accuracy
under_55_pid <- acc_check_exp3 |>
  filter(perc_acc < 55) |>
  pull(pid)

# Ratings check — load all ratings files and assign pid
data_ratings_exp3 <- list.files(
  here("exp_3", "data"),
  pattern      = "Ratings.*csv",
  full.names   = TRUE,
  recursive    = TRUE
) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_csv, col_names = c("Image_ID", "Fam_ratings", "Val_ratings", "Chosen_name")) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "file") |>
  mutate(pid = rep(1:40, each = 60)) |>
  select(-file)

# Participants with fewer than 30 familiarity ratings >= 7
exclude_ratings_exp3 <- data_ratings_exp3 |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(n_fam = sum(Fam_ratings > 6)) |>
  filter(n_fam < 30, !pid %in% under_55_pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# Final retained participant list
list_participant_analysis_3 <- data_exp3 |>
  filter(
    !pid %in% over_95_pid,
    !pid %in% under_55_pid,
    !pid %in% exclude_ratings_exp3
  ) |>
  distinct(pid) |>
  pull(pid)

# Scalar counts for inline text
over_95               <- length(over_95_pid)
under_55              <- length(under_55_pid)
ratings_only          <- length(exclude_ratings_exp3)
number_participant_3  <- length(list_participant_analysis_3)
```

## from Raph

```{r}
#| label: LBA-exp1
#| include: false
load(here("exp_1", "models", "LBA_exp1_v1.RData"))
param_1_pid = EMC2::parameters(LBA_exp1_v1,selection="alpha", N = NULL)

split_tibble <- function(tibble, col = 'col') tibble |> split(., .[, col])
array_theta_1 <- split_tibble(param_1_pid, "subjects")
array_theta_1<-do.call(rbind, array_theta_1)
array_theta_pid_1 <- array_theta_1 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("v_SNovel:lMTRUE", "v_SNovel:lMFALSE", "v_SLearned:lMTRUE", "v_SLearned:lMFALSE", "sv_lMTRUE", "B_lRNovel", "B_lRLearned", "A", "t0"), names_to = "param", values_to = "value")|>
  add_column(datapoint = rep(1:15000,each=9,times=30))|> #here 30'000 = number of chains (3) x number of iteration (5'000)
  rename(pid=subjects)

#Average across participants
theta_group_1 <- array_theta_pid_1 |>
  group_by(datapoint,param) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  add_column(pid = "average") |> ## add a column which makes clear it is the avg. not needed but useful for plotting later
  relocate(pid, .before = everything())


#Quantile at the group level
theta_group_1_q <- theta_group_1 |>
  group_by(param) |>
  median_qi(value)


#And per pid
theta_pid_1_q <- array_theta_pid_1 |>
  group_by(pid, param) |>
  median_qi(value)

```

```{r}
#| label: thresh-pid
#| include: false
thresh_pid_1 <- array_theta_pid_1 |>
  filter(str_detect(param, "B_")) |>
  mutate(response = if_else(str_detect(param, "lRLearned"), "Learned", "Novel"),
         response = factor(response,
                            levels = c("Novel", "Learned")))
```

```{r}

  filter(str_detect(param, "B_")) |>
  mutate(response = if_else(str_detect(param, "lRLearned"), "Learned", "Novel"),
         response = factor(response,
                            levels = c("Novel", "Learned")))
```

```{r}
  mutate(diff = Novel - Learned)

#Quantiles
thresh_diff_pid_1_q <- thresh_diff_pid_1 |>

```

```{r}
#| label: drift-pid

drift_rate_pid_1 <- array_theta_pid_1 |>
  filter(str_detect(param, "v_S")) |>
  mutate(condition = if_else(str_detect(param, "Novel"), "Novel", "Learned"),
         accuracy = if_else(str_detect(param, "TRUE"), "True", "False"),
         condition = factor(condition,
                            levels = c("Novel", "Learned")),
         accuracy = factor(accuracy,
                            levels = c("False", "True")))

## just true > false differences (accuracy)
drift_acc_diff_pid_1 <- drift_rate_pid_1 |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = -param,
               names_from = accuracy,
               values_from = value) |>
  mutate(diff = True - False)


## Novel > Learned differences

  pivot_wider(id_cols = -c("True", "False"),
              names_from = condition,
              values_from = diff) |>
  mutate(diff = Novel - Learned)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-thresh_exp1
#| fig-cap: "Threshold estimates for Experiment 1: (a) Posterior distribution of the average threshold parameter by response option (Novel / Learned). (b) Difference between the posterior distribution of the average threshold parameter for the Novel response option and the Learned response option. Note that the points are median values, whereas the black lines represent the 80% credible intervals (thick) and 95% credible intervals (thin)."
#| fig-subcap:
#|  - "Threshold by response"
#|  - "Threshold difference (Novel > Learned)"
#| layout-ncol: 2

ggplot(thresh_group_1, aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(response))) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7, aes(fill = response)) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe") +
  scale_colour_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe")  +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(y="Response", x="Threshold") +
  labs(fill = "Response") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(thresh_diff_1, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.9, fill="firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(x = "Threshold", y="Density")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-drift_exp1
#| fig-cap: "Drift rate estimates for Experiment 1. (a) Posterior distribution of the average drift rate difference (TRUE - FALSE) by stimulus familiarity condition (Novel / Learned). (b) Difference between the posterior distribution of the average drift rate parameter (TRUE - FALSE) of the Novel condition and the Learned condition. Note that the points are median values, whereas the black lines represent the 80% credible intervals (thick) and 95% credible intervals (thin)."
#| fig-subcap:
#|  - "Drift rate (TRUE - FALSE) by familiarity condition"
#|  - "Drift rate difference (Novel > Learned)"
#| layout-ncol: 2


ggplot(drift_acc_diff_1, aes(x = diff, y = fct_rev(condition))) +
  stat_halfeye(aes(fill = condition), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe") +
  scale_colour_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe")  +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Drift rate", y="Familiarity")

ggplot(drift_acc_cond_diff_1, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
  stat_halfeye(fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(x="Drift rate", y="") +
  xlim(0,3)
```
